entries.name: Codebase Audit Rules — team-rule compliance, slop, dead code, production risk
entries.description: Applies to any repo running a full-codebase audit (`workflows/codebase-audit.md`) or a diff/slice audit.
entries.scope: Any repo or slice under audit

rules.title: Module context
rules.content:
0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies.

Applies to any repo running a full-codebase audit (`workflows/codebase-audit.md`) or a diff/slice audit.

rules.title: Every source file gets a verdict
rules.content: 1. **Every source file gets a verdict** — `clean` or one or more findings. A slice audit completes when every file in the slice carries a verdict.

rules.title: Every finding cites `file:line` evidence
rules.content: 2. **Every finding cites `file:line` evidence** — Include `file:line`, category, and a one-line description. Re-verify dead-code claims with a repo-wide exact-word `rg -w` count before flagging (re-exports and test seams count as live).

rules.title: Report before fixing
rules.content: 3. **Report before fixing** — Present the merged report and wait for human approval before editing. Re-run `bun fmt`, `bun lint --no-script --allow-unsupported`, typecheck, and tests after applying fixes.

rules.title: Comments carry what code cannot
rules.content:
4. **Comments carry what code cannot** — Classify every comment and keep only the ones that carry non-obvious information:
   - **Tautology** — restates the adjacent code; delete it.
   - **Stale** — names removed code or a past implementation; delete it.
   - **Excuse** — justifies a hack (`TODO:`, `FIXME`, `ponytail:`, `workaround`); delete it and file one aggregate issue for the fix.
   - **Decision** — records a non-obvious choice; keep it in place, and move it to an ADR only when it is hard to reverse, surprising without context, and the result of a real trade-off.
   When a comment is ambiguous and deletion would lose information, keep it and open an issue. Never delete a whole design block because a marker appears deep inside it. Ratchet removals against a pinned commit with `git diff`, so no generated baseline file needs maintenance when code changes.

rules.title: Trusted paths run bare
rules.content: 5. **Trusted paths run bare** — Flag defensive null-checks, try/catch wrappers, and fallback defaults on internal calls whose contract we control end to end.

rules.title: Types are real types
rules.content: 6. **Types are real types** — Flag `as any`, `as unknown as T`, `@ts-ignore`, and bare `!` non-null assertions that silence the compiler instead of validating or typing the boundary.

rules.title: Abstractions earn their second use
rules.content: 7. **Abstractions earn their second use** — Flag single-implementation interfaces, single-product factories, and pass-through wrappers; inline them.

rules.title: Early returns over deep nesting
rules.content: 8. **Early returns over deep nesting** — Flag nesting past three levels that guard clauses flatten.

rules.title: The file reads as one hand
rules.content: 9. **The file reads as one hand** — Flag naming, error handling, or import conventions that clash with the surrounding file.

rules.title: Zero inline suppression directives
rules.content: 10. **Zero inline suppression directives** — Grep each slice for `eslint-disable`, `oxlint-disable`, `oxlint-ignore`, `biome-ignore`, `ts-ignore`, `ts-expect-error`, and `prettier-ignore`. In baseline `bun lint`, inline disables are ignored dead code (`rules/linting.md` #10): fix the code or move legitimate framework carve-outs into a scoped config `overrides` block with a reason comment. In ESLint/typecheck where directives run, any surviving directive must be single-line with a blocker reason.

rules.title: Every test fails on a real regression
rules.content: 11. **Every test fails on a real regression** — Flag tests with no assertions, tautologies (`expect(true).toBe(true)`), and mock-echoes (asserting what a mock was stubbed to return). Replace slop tests covering live behavior with behavioral tests in the same pass — never just delete coverage.

rules.title: No secrets in the tree
rules.content: 12. **No secrets in the tree** — Flag keys, tokens, and connection strings in source, committed env files, or git history; rotate first, clean second.

rules.title: Dependency health
rules.content: 13. **Dependency health** — Flag known CVEs (`pnpm audit --audit-level=high`), deprecated packages, duplicate library versions, and incompatible licenses.

rules.title: Failures surface & logs stay PII-free
rules.content: 14. **Failures surface & logs stay PII-free** — Flag empty catches, swallowed promise rejections, log-and-continue on money/data paths, and personal identifiers (emails, tokens, phone numbers) in logs or telemetry.

rules.title: Bounded state & resource cleanup
rules.content: 15. **Bounded state & resource cleanup** — Flag unbounded in-memory `Map`/`Set` collections (missing `MAX_ENTRIES`/TTL/FIFO eviction), SSE endpoints missing `res.once('close')`, dangling stream readers/timers on unmount, and render-phase `URL.createObjectURL` calls (`rules/frontend.md` #18, `rules/nestjs.md` #24).

rules.title: No dead exports, unreachable branches, commented-out code, or stale config refs
rules.content: 16. **No dead exports, unreachable branches, commented-out code, or stale config refs** — Flag exports with zero repo-wide consumers, conditions no caller can satisfy, commented-out code blocks, and env vars/scripts/paths missing from `package.json` or `.env.example`. Extend the sweep to ADR/PRD/README/CI comments and framework shortcuts that still describe a deleted symbol (`rules/general.md` #21).

rules.title: Rule, config, and library compliance
rules.content: 17. **Rule, config, and library compliance** — Discover the project's applicable modules through the rules MCP and check every file against them (`rule`), compare local lint/format/Dependabot configs against `configs/` (`config-drift`), and verify every covered concern uses its assigned library in `rules/libraries.md` (`library`).

rules.title: Slice-type checks
rules.content:
18. **Slice-type checks**:
    - **Frontend**: interactive controls carry accessible names (`aria-hidden="true"` on icon-font ligatures), keyboard/focus flows work, WCAG AA contrast passes, object URLs revoke on unmount, no unlayered CSS resets overriding Tailwind v4 `@layer utilities`, and UI/UX tokens, responsive layouts, component naming, and copy adhere to root `DESIGN.md` (`rules/frontend.md` #21). Scan slices with Modern Web Guidance (`npx modern-web-guidance legacy-scan <slice> --json`) and assert: custom Enter keydown listeners are IME-safe (`rules/frontend.md` #28), scrollbars declare standard `scrollbar-color` in `@layer base` (`rules/frontend.md` #29), text controls style `:user-invalid` and `aria-invalid` (`rules/frontend.md` #30), and primary above-the-fold media declares `priority` (`rules/frontend.md` #31).
    - **Prisma**: migrations checked for destructive ops and schema drift (`prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema prisma --exit-code`), queried columns indexed, `select` shapes include required relations (`rules/prisma.md`).
    - **API**: every route enforces auth guards, every trust boundary validates with a DTO class, stateful maps bounded, streaming endpoints handle disconnect (`rules/nestjs.md`).
    - **i18n**: all UI chrome strings live in `{vi,en}` catalogs with parity, zero machinery or enum leaks in catalogs or `.tsx` sources, generated index/error-code files current (`rules/i18n.md` #18–22).
    - **Fixtures**: seed/fixture paths typechecked and excluded from the runtime build, production algorithms imported (not copied), one model registry, per-domain RNG and timezone anchor, one persona registry, schema-coupled defaults asserted, destructive guard fail-closed (`rules/fixtures.md`).
    - **E2E**: one env/port module, one persona registry, one coverage fixture, no hardcoded origins, skip-not-pass on missing fixtures, asserted cleanup, gated-route parity, no bare `test.fail()` removal (`rules/e2e-testing.md` #16–20).
    - **Infra & Docker**: all `Dockerfile`s (`infra/docker/api.Dockerfile`, parameterized `infra/docker/portal.Dockerfile`) and reverse-proxy configs (`infra/nginx/default.conf`) live under `infra/` with a single root `.dockerignore` and zero scattered `apps/*/Dockerfile` or `apps/*/.dockerignore` files (`rules/github-vps-deploy.md` #9).

entries.title: Dependabot & Override Hygiene Rules
entries.name: Dependabot & Override Hygiene Rules
entries.description: Applies to every repo with `.github/dependabot.yml` (copy `configs/dependabot.yml` as the starting baseline). Every version source in the repo must be covered by a matching ecosystem entry.
entries.scope: Repos with `.github/dependabot.yml`

rules.title: Module context
rules.content:
0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies.

Applies to every repo with `.github/dependabot.yml` (copy `configs/dependabot.yml` as the starting baseline). Every version source in the repo must be covered by a matching ecosystem entry.

rules.title: Match the ecosystem to the actual lockfile and container manifest
rules.content:
1. **Match the ecosystem to the actual lockfile and container manifest** — Mismatched ecosystems fail the Dependabot job outright with `dependency_file_not_found` rather than skipping cleanly (Precedent: VibeHost 2026-10 — `npm` on a `bun.lock` repo and `docker` on a compose-only repo both aborted):

   | Version source                      | Ecosystem        | Condition                                   |
   | ----------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
   | `package.json` dependencies         | `bun`            | repo uses `bun.lock`                        |
   | `package.json` dependencies         | `npm`            | repo uses `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `package-lock.json`, or `yarn.lock` |
   | `.github/workflows/*` action refs   | `github-actions` | always                                      |
   | `FROM <image>:<tag>` in Dockerfiles | `docker`         | `Dockerfile` or Kubernetes YAML exists (list plain `directories:`, never globs) |
   | `image:` in `docker-compose*.yml`   | `docker-compose` | compose file exists                         |

rules.title: Bump `packageManager` manually in one PR
rules.content: 2. **Bump `packageManager` manually in one PR** — Dependabot has no `package-manager-versions` ecosystem (its validator rejects that string — Precedent: 2026-09). Update `package.json#packageManager`, refresh the lockfile (`pnpm install --lockfile-only` or `bun install`), update `engines`/`devEngines` if needed, and verify `git grep <old-version>` returns zero hits outside changelogs.

rules.title: Group `minor` + `patch`; keep `major` PRs individual (`open-pull-requests-limit: 5`)
rules.content: 3. **Group `minor` + `patch`; keep `major` PRs individual (`open-pull-requests-limit: 5`)** — Group routine updates under `groups.minor-and-patch` (`patterns: ["*"]`, `update-types: ["minor", "patch"]`) so each major breaking upgrade gets its own isolated CI run.

rules.title: Never `ignore` a major without a rationale comment
rules.content: 4. **Never `ignore` a major without a rationale comment** — Security PRs bypass `ignore` anyway and land on the old major; document any mandatory major pin right above its `ignore:` block.

rules.title: Keep workflow actions SHA-pinned
rules.content: 5. **Keep workflow actions SHA-pinned** — Use `uses: owner/repo@<40-char-sha> # v1.2.3`; Dependabot updates both the commit SHA and the trailing version comment.

rules.title: Single source of truth for `overrides` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
rules.content: 6. **Single source of truth for `overrides` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`** — `pnpm-workspace.yaml#overrides` completely shadows root `package.json#overrides`; delete any duplicate root `package.json` `overrides` block so edits never silently no-op. To bump a pinned transitive dependency for `pnpm audit`, update the pin in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` first, then run bare `pnpm update <pkg>` (passing an explicit `@version` is rejected when a pin exists) and confirm `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` exits `0` (Precedent: XaDaoXa 2026-09, PRs #257–#259).

rules.title: Enforce `minimumReleaseAge: 10080` (7 days) in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
rules.content:
7. **Enforce `minimumReleaseAge: 10080` (7 days) in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`** — Since pnpm v11, non-auth settings live in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (not `.npmrc`). `minimumReleaseAge: 10080` blocks under-age versions during both Dependabot and CI `--frozen-lockfile` installs (Precedent: 2026-09 — caught 4 packages <7d old on first run). Exempt manually reviewed upgrades with exact `name@version` or name-only wildcard `"@oxfmt/binding-*"` and enable auto-pruning:

   ```yaml
   # pnpm-workspace.yaml
   minimumReleaseAge: 10080
   minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
     - cn@0.2.3
     - "@oxfmt/binding-*"
   minimumReleaseAgeExcludePrune: true
   ```

entries.title: E2E Testing Rules — Playwright against a real API
entries.name: E2E Testing Rules — Playwright against a real API
entries.description: Applies to any repo running Playwright e2e tests against a real backend and real seeded data. Consumers running only unit tests omit this file.
entries.scope: Repos with Playwright e2e tests against a real API

rules.title: Module context
rules.content:
0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies.

Applies to any repo running Playwright e2e tests against a real backend and real seeded data. Consumers running only unit tests omit this file.

rules.title: `getByText(str)` is substring + case-insensitive by default — pass `{ exact: true }` or scope to a container
rules.content:
1. **`getByText(str)` is substring + case-insensitive by default — pass `{ exact: true }` or scope to a container** — Never trust `page.getByText('Kiểm định').first()` on a page where headings or related cards contain the same substring:

   ```ts
   const badge = page.getByText('Kiểm định', { exact: true }).first();
   ```

rules.title: Correlate API-fetched entities with their exact UI container
rules.content: 2. **Correlate API-fetched entities with their exact UI container** — When asserting on an entity fetched via `GET /things?limit=1`, scope the UI locator to that entity's unique id/href/title rather than `.first()` on a generic card class (sort order or related-item grids may render a different entity first).

rules.title: `.first()` IS valid when multiple domain items legitimately share a display label
rules.content: 3. **`.first()` IS valid when multiple domain items legitimately share a display label** — Booking *any* available slot at `"09:00"` across multiple staff uses `.first()`; a strict-mode failure on identical valid labels means the locator was over-constrained for the domain.

rules.title: Headless overlay click fallback
rules.content: 4. **Headless overlay click fallback** — When a `.click()` on a confirmed-visible sheet/portal option silently no-ops in headless mode, use `.focus()` followed by ` page.keyboard.press('Enter')`.

rules.title: Replicate the app's client mapper when injecting state directly
rules.content: 5. **Replicate the app's client mapper when injecting state directly** — Before calling `page.evaluate((p) => store.go('itemDetail', p), payload)`, transform the raw API response through the same field renames and defaults (`images: raw.photos ?? []`) the real client mapper applies so tests never trigger false-positive crashes on raw wire shapes.

rules.title: Search wider pages when seed data is sparse
rules.content: 6. **Search wider pages when seed data is sparse** — When only a subset of seeded entities carries a relation (e.g. videos on 3 of 20 trainers), fetch `?limit=20`, loop until a qualifying entity is found, and `expect(match).toBeTruthy()` before testing the flow.

rules.title: Wrap genuine out-of-scope app bugs in `test.fail()`, never weaken assertions
rules.content: 7. **Wrap genuine out-of-scope app bugs in `test.fail()`, never weaken assertions** — Keep the strict assertion intact and call `test.fail()` with a comment naming the bug/follow-up. CI stays green now and turns red automatically once the underlying bug is fixed (signaling removal of `test.fail()`).

rules.title: Avoid literal copy assertions where role/testid works; sweep `
rules.content: 8. **Avoid literal copy assertions where role/testid works; sweep `**/*.spec.ts` on copy rewrites** — Asserting literal UI text couples specs to wording changes. Prefer role/testid locators unless copy itself is under test; whenever `rules/i18n.md` (#14) renames catalog copy, grep and update `**/*.spec.ts` in the same commit (Precedent: "Trainer nổi bật" → "HLV nổi bật" broke 3 specs post-merge).

rules.title: Match CI's production build+start command locally
rules.content: 9. **Match CI's production build+start command locally** — Framework dev-mode checks (e.g. Next.js instant-navigation validation) can abort routes that production builds serve cleanly.

rules.title: Pin `localhost` vs `127.0.0.1` identically across `baseURL`, `webServer.url`, and API env vars
rules.content: 10. **Pin `localhost` vs `127.0.0.1` identically across `baseURL`, `webServer.url`, and API env vars** — Browsers treat `localhost` and `127.0.0.1` as separate origins; an `httpOnly` login cookie set on one silently misses page loads on the other, bouncing every authenticated test back to `/login`.

rules.title: Idempotent seed data & pre-run reset
rules.content: 11. **Idempotent seed data & pre-run reset** — Reset and reseed before every full run when specs perform unrollback-able mutations (password changes, account creation) or use sequential IDs.

rules.title: Free known ports before full and isolated runs
rules.content: 12. **Free known ports before full and isolated runs** — Kill stale listeners (`lsof -tiTCP:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill`) and clear leftover `BASE_URL` env overrides so `webServer` never attaches to a stale server from a prior run.

rules.title: Configure `{ mode: 'serial' }` when tests in a `describe` share `beforeAll` state
rules.content: 13. **Configure `{ mode: 'serial' }` when tests in a `describe` share `beforeAll` state** — Under `fullyParallel`, Playwright scatters tests in one `describe` across workers (`beforeAll` runs once per worker); add `test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' })` whenever tests share setup or sequence.

rules.title: Distinguish `--workers=1` contention from real failures
rules.content: 14. **Distinguish `--workers=1` contention from real failures** — Re-run a suspect failure in isolation with `--workers=1` against a clean server: if it passes, it is shared-DB parallel contention (document it); if it still fails, fix the test helper or app code before shipping.

rules.title: Browser jobs select a capable runner and install the browser in the job
rules.content: 14b. **Browser jobs select a capable runner and install the browser in the job** — Do not assume a self-hosted pool is homogeneous: a host with a `PREEMPT_RT` kernel can hang every Chrome build at startup (100% CPU, no CDP). Require a capability label (`runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, playwright]`) and run `bunx playwright install chromium` in the job — a no-op on provisioned hosts, a recovery path after a cache wipe. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — 120 specs failed on `sang-server-3`; the xiro runners were labelled `playwright`.

rules.title: Exclude screenshot-only smoke specs, include shared flow helpers (`helpers/flows.ts`), and triage dual-matcher disagreements
rules.content: 15. **Exclude screenshot-only smoke specs, include shared flow helpers (`helpers/flows.ts`), and triage dual-matcher disagreements** — Run both a loose substring matcher and a strict path-regex matcher (`:param` → `[^/'"\`]+`), print every row where they disagree, and inspect each disagreement by hand.

rules.title: One `support/env.ts` owns every origin and port
rules.content: 16. **One `support/env.ts` owns every origin and port** — Specs import `E2E_API_URL`, `E2E_WEB_URL`, `E2E_PORTAL_URL`, `E2E_MINIAPP_URL`, and the port map from one module. No `http://localhost:NNNN` literal in a spec. `E2E_BASE_URL` must actually redirect the browser and the API destination; when the suite owns its listeners, pin the API URL and refuse a runner-level override. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — 25 specs carried private copies and `E2E_BASE_URL` changed nothing.

rules.title: One persona registry, shared with the seed
rules.content: 17. **One persona registry, shared with the seed** — Names, emails, roles, landing routes, and the password live in one module imported by `auth.setup`, the seed's protected-account guard, and the specs (`rules/fixtures.md` #5). Mint storage states only for personas a spec actually uses.

rules.title: One test fixture wraps `test` with coverage
rules.content: 18. **One test fixture wraps `test` with coverage** — Every spec imports `test`/`expect` from `support/fixtures`, never from `@playwright/test` directly. The wrapper records navigations and API hits for every spec, so coverage is not opt-in by import path. A pure API spec still uses the same fixture.

rules.title: Skip, do not pass, when a fixture is absent
rules.content: 19. **Skip, do not pass, when a fixture is absent** — A paid/full-path spec that needs a receiver, plan, or provider row calls `test.skip(true, '<missing fixture>')` when the row is absent. Assert cleanup before the test ends; never `.catch(() => null)` it away. An unknown role or account fails loudly instead of falling back to `PLAYER`. Keep the gated-route list equal to the app's gated page list; a missing route is a silent hole.

rules.title: Removing `test.fail()` requires a fix or a linked bug
rules.content: 20. **Removing `test.fail()` requires a fix or a linked bug** — A drift check that fails is a red test, not a reason to delete the marker. Fix the product copy/behavior, or keep `test.fail()` with a comment naming the issue. Never remove it only to make CI green. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — the certified-paddle badge differed between card and detail; the marker was removed before the copy was unified.

rules.title: The browser suite runs in CI
rules.content: 21. **The browser suite runs in CI** — A suite that CI never runs is a local habit, not a check. Add a path-filtered job that starts the fixture and app services, waits for health, installs or selects a browser, and runs `test:e2e` and its variant scripts. Keep the pre-commit hook fast; the full browser run belongs in CI. Precedent: owobot-tools 2026-11 — 42 cases existed in `apps/console`, but CI ran only lint, typecheck, test, and build; the real-user pass was requested three times before it became a gate.

rules.title: One command owns the fixture stack
rules.content: 22. **One command owns the fixture stack** — `test:e2e` starts the mock API and the app, waits for both health endpoints, and stops them on exit. A manual mock server plus a manual dev server invites stale ports and duplicate-server errors. If the Playwright browser download stalls, pin the installed Chrome channel in the config instead of retrying the download.

entries.name: Fixtures & Seed Rules — one contract for dev, tests, and e2e
entries.description: Applies to any repo with seed scripts, fixture generators, demo data, or a deterministic test database. Consumers without fixtures omit this file.
entries.scope: Repos with seed scripts, fixture generators, or a deterministic test DB

rules.title: Module context
rules.content:
0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies.

Applies to any repo with seed scripts, fixture generators, demo data, or a deterministic test database. Consumers without fixtures omit this file.

rules.title: Typecheck the fixture and keep it out of the runtime build
rules.content: 1. **Typecheck the fixture and keep it out of the runtime build** — Put seed/fixture paths inside the repo's typecheck program (or a dedicated `tsconfig.seed.json` included by the root gate), and exclude them from `tsconfig.build.json`. A seed that only runs is a seed that drifts. The root gate must fail on a broken fixture.

rules.title: Import the production algorithm; never copy it
rules.content: 2. **Import the production algorithm; never copy it** — Crypto envelopes, transfer-memo/ID formats, plan and price catalogs, embedding/model configuration, storage disks, and status transitions come from the owning production module. If the fixture needs a deterministic variant, extract one pure function used by both. A copied algorithm makes the fixture lie.

rules.title: One model registry drives reset and idempotency
rules.content: 3. **One model registry drives reset and idempotency** — Keep one ordered list of owned models in foreign-key-safe delete order. It feeds both the reset and the row-count check. Constrain the list to real client keys so a renamed model is a type error, and make a new model one row. Never keep a second count list.

rules.title: Deterministic generation is per domain
rules.content: 4. **Deterministic generation is per domain** — Give each seed domain its own RNG instance, seeded from the domain name. A shared global sequence makes adding or reordering a domain change another domain's rows. Dates use one explicit timezone anchor (`TZDate`); never host-local `new Date()`/`setHours()` for fixture data. Test the anchor under `TZ=UTC`.

rules.title: One persona registry
rules.content: 5. **One persona registry** — The seed and the e2e suite import the same account list (name, email, role, route, password). The seed's protected-account guard uses that list. Specs carry no email literals.

rules.title: Schema-coupled defaults have one registry and a write-time assertion
rules.content: 6. **Schema-coupled defaults have one registry and a write-time assertion** — Vector dimensions, model names, enum defaults, and plan prices live together. The fixture asserts the value's shape before insert (for example, the embedding length equals the column width), and the default model and endpoint come from the same pair.

rules.title: Destructive fixtures fail closed
rules.content: 7. **Destructive fixtures fail closed** — A seed that writes or deletes production-shaped data requires an explicit opt-in env var and a local-host check by default. Keep the guard a pure function with a negative test. An unreadable guard file is a failure, not a skip.

rules.title: Fixture copy follows the catalog
rules.content:
8. **Fixture copy follows the catalog** — Seed strings that users see obey `rules/i18n.md` #13. Display labels stay in the message catalog, never in a shared types package.

Completion criterion: a second run changes no owned row count, a fresh checkout's root gate typechecks the fixture, and the protected personas still sign in.

rules.title: Module context
rules.content:
0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies.

Applies to browser clients in the organization (React/Next.js web apps, admin portals, mobile-web miniapps). Repos with i18n additionally include `rules/i18n.md`.

rules.title: Axios generic type parameter, never manual unwrap
rules.content: 1. **Axios generic type parameter, never manual unwrap** — Declare response types via `const { data } = await api.get<MyType>('/endpoint')` and return `data`. Never write `data?.data as Type` or custom `unwrap()` helpers — the `lib/client.ts` response interceptor unwraps `{ data: T }` envelopes.

rules.title: Native multipart helpers & `FormData` passthrough
rules.content: 2. **Native multipart helpers & `FormData` passthrough** — Use `api.postForm<T>()` / `putForm` / `patchForm` for uploads; never hand-roll `toFormData` (native helpers skip `undefined`/`null`, repeat `File[]` per key, and match the server serializer). *Sole exception*: a single port-boundary `toFormData` inside a transport-agnostic `RequestPort` (`@repo/api-client` / `@scope/contracts`) shared with a `fetch` adapter, which **must** accept `Record<string, unknown> | FormData` and pass pre-built `FormData` instances through untouched (`body instanceof FormData ? body : toFormData(body)` — passing `FormData` into `Object.entries` yields `{}` and sends an empty upload body; Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10).

rules.title: Wire real API data once the endpoint exists; use Ponytail mock hooks only before it lands
Tailwind v4 utilities only
rules.content: 4. **Tailwind v4 utilities only** — No hand-rolled CSS files or inline `style={{}}` objects. Use v4 utility names (`shadow-xs`, `shadow-sm`, `rounded-xs`, `rounded-sm`, `shrink-0`, `outline-hidden`, `max-w-[24rem]`, `bg-linear-<angle> from-x to-y`; `ring-offset-*` is removed; `shadow-md/lg/xl` and `tracking-wider` remain valid). Check `AGENTS.md` or the theme config when unsure.

rules.title: Cascade-layer hygiene & `@source` in Tailwind v4
rules.content: 5. **Cascade-layer hygiene & `@source` in Tailwind v4** — In CSS Cascade Layers, **any unlayered rule beats every `@layer` rule** regardless of specificity (`* { margin: 0; padding: 0; }` unlayered zeroes out every `@layer utilities` `p-*`/`px-*`/`m-*`/`mx-auto` class). When porting `.dc.html` / `tokens.css` into a Tailwind v4 app (`@import "tailwindcss"`), drop duplicate resets or wrap element resets in `@layer base` and custom classes in `@layer components`. When `globals.css` sits in `apps/*/src/app/globals.css`, add `@source "../";` plus `@source` paths for shared UI packages (`@source "../../../../packages/ui/src";`) so Turbopack scans all components (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10).

rules.title: Colors and dimensions are `@theme` design tokens, never literals (`lint:tokens` zero-baseline ratchet)
rules.content: 6. **Colors and dimensions are `@theme` design tokens, never literals (`lint:tokens` zero-baseline ratchet)** — Define shared tokens in `tokens.css` and app tokens in `globals.css` (`@theme inline`); reference them via generated classes (`bg-ph-bg`, `text-tier-low-strong`) or `var(--color-x)` in JS style maps. Replace Tailwind v3 arbitrary pixel values (`backdrop-blur-[2px]`, `max-w-[1280px]`, `text-[10px]`, `tracking-[0.2em]`) with Tailwind v4 tokens (`backdrop-blur-xs`, `max-w-7xl`, `text-xs`, `tracking-widest`). Once `scripts/tokens-baseline.json` reaches `{}` (`0` files holding legacy leaks), lock the baseline at zero so `lint:tokens` rejects any new `#hex` or `[...px]` literal immediately (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). Keep raw hex **only** where CSS variables cannot resolve: token definitions, `var(--color-x, #hex)` fallbacks, `themeColor` meta tags, `<canvas>`, SVG `fill`/`stroke` attributes, and brand/chart-series data maps.

rules.title: Deep-module boundaries by default (`oxc/no-barrel-file: "error"`)
rules.content: 7. **Deep-module boundaries by default (`oxc/no-barrel-file: "error"`)** — Import workspace packages only through declared `package.json#exports` entry points (`@scope/pkg`, `@scope/pkg/subpath`) and import app-internal modules directly by file path (use relative paths when shorter than `@/` alias; keep same-folder imports relative). Forbid `export *` folder barrels. *Legacy exception*: in repos that have not enabled `oxc/no-barrel-file`, folders with ≥2 non-test files maintain an `index.ts` barrel and never import their own barrel from within the same folder.

rules.title: 300-line hard cap (`max-lines: 300`), one screen = one file, fold into shared UI
rules.content: 8. **300-line hard cap (`max-lines: 300`), one screen = one file, fold into shared UI** — Target **≤250 formatted lines** when authoring new files and split >300-line monoliths in-place (behavior identical): multi-view screens → thin shell + per-view files; `hooks.ts` → per-domain `use-<resource>.ts`; `lib/data` → per-domain `<domain>.ts` (delete dead exports/mocks during the split). Shared multi-variant components live **once** in the shared UI package using `cva` + `import { cn } from 'cn'` — fold new tones/variants (`Badge`, `Input`) into the shared component and delete app-local copies (`Pill`, `Btn`, `INPUT_CLASS`).

rules.title: Route editor vs modal form
rules.content: 9. **Route editor vs modal form** — Full-page create/edit flows share one route-editor component across `/path/new` + `/path/[id]` (`isNew = !id || id === 'new'`), never page-level `useState`. Use `*FormModal` dialogs only for inline edits triggered from a list page.

rules.title: Next.js 16 conventions (`src/proxy.ts` & default Turbopack)
rules.content: 10. **Next.js 16 conventions (`src/proxy.ts` & default Turbopack)** — Name request hooks `src/proxy.ts` exporting `export function proxy(request: NextRequest)` (Next.js 16 ignores deprecated `middleware.ts`). Run `next dev` and `next build` with default Turbopack (never `--webpack`). Ignore `**/next-env.d.ts` in `.gitignore`, `.oxfmtrc.json`, and `.oxlintrc.json` so dev/build route-type switches never dirty git; delete any tool-scaffolded `apps/*/AGENTS.md`. In Bun multi-app monorepos, symlink `apps/<app>/node_modules/.bin -> ../../../node_modules/.bin` in `postinstall` (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10).

rules.title: Single Axios client in `lib/client.ts` & controller route/verb parity in `lib/api.ts`
rules.content: 11. **Single Axios client in `lib/client.ts` & controller route/verb parity in `lib/api.ts`** — Configure `axios.create({ baseURL, headers })` with: (a) auth request interceptor, (b) response error interceptor normalizing messages to `` `${method} ${path} → ${status}` ``, and (c) response unwrap interceptor only if the API wraps `{ data: T }`. Endpoint functions live in `lib/api.ts`. Before wiring portal `lib/api.ts` functions against a backend module, verify the exact `@Controller('prefix')` + `@Get/@Post/@Patch/@Delete` path and verb in `apps/api` (e.g. plural `/tutors/me` vs `/tutor/me`, `/classes/client` vs `/client/classes`, `POST /finance/checkout` vs `GET`, `/admin/tutors/verification-queue` vs `/kyc-queue` — Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). Use `fetch` (sharing `baseURL` + `authHeader()`) **only** for SSE/NDJSON streaming endpoints. **Miniapp exemption**: Zalo miniapp keeps its local `fetch` client (`api/client.ts`) and local components (ADR-0039).

rules.title: `QueryProvider` & typed `use-<resource>.ts` hooks
rules.content: 12. **`QueryProvider` & typed `use-<resource>.ts` hooks** — Wrap `QueryClientProvider` once at the root layout (`useState(() => new QueryClient())`); never fetch in `useEffect`. Centralize keys in `lib/query-keys.ts` and include `userId ?? 'anon'` on user-private caches; set `retry: false` on auth/session queries; update cache in a single layer (hook `onSuccess` OR form callback, never both); type `qc.setQueryData<MyType>(key, ...)` via generic; extract multi-query cache transitions into pure unit-tested `apply<Domain>Event(qc, event)` helpers in `lib/data/<domain>-cache.ts`.

rules.title: Forms (`react-hook-form` + `zodResolver`) mirror the backend DTO
rules.content:
13. **Forms (`react-hook-form` + `zodResolver`) mirror the backend DTO** — Colocate `<form>-schema.ts` next to the form with a comment citing the backend DTO path; wire i18n error messages via `const schema = (t: TranslatorLike) => z.object(...)`. Skip RHF only for trivial `required`-only forms.
    - **Zod v4 input ≠ output (`z.coerce` / `.transform()`)**: pass three generics `useForm<z.input<S>, unknown, z.output<S>>()` (and `Control<In, unknown, Out>`) — never cast `as unknown as Resolver<...>`. Render coerced inputs as `value={field.value == null ? '' : String(field.value)}`.
    - **Input normalization parity**: strip formatting separators (`value.replace(/[\s.-]/gu, '')`) before regex checks (e.g. VN phone `/^0\d{9,10}$/`) and pair positive-number constraints with HTML `min="1"` (Precedent: Ecopick 2026-10, PR #452).

rules.title: Escape JSX entities & data-drive repeated blocks/collections
rules.content: 14. **Escape JSX entities & data-drive repeated blocks/collections** — Escape literal `'`, `"`, `<`, `>`, `{`, `}` in JSX text (`'`, `"`, `<`, `>`, `{`, `}`). Render repeated option/tab/field rows from module-level `{ value, labelKey } as const` arrays via `.map`. Replace accumulator loops (`out.push(...)`) with `.map` / `.flatMap` / `Array.from` / `Object.fromEntries` (keep `for`/`while` only for early-exit scans, sequential state machines, or side-effect loops), and extract duplicate loop bodies into a shared helper.

rules.title: Hooks run unconditionally before any early return
rules.content: 15. **Hooks run unconditionally before any early return** — Place every `useState`/`useEffect`/`useMemo` above all `if (isLoading) return ...` guards; a hook after an early return crashes React the instant `isLoading` flips (Precedent: tournament live-tracker crash).

rules.title: Verify untyped route registries, shared lookup maps, modal flags & sibling screens
rules.content:
16. **Verify untyped route registries, shared lookup maps, modal flags & sibling screens** —
    - **Dispatch tables (`params: unknown`)**: grep every real `go('screen', ...)` / `push(...)` caller to confirm the passed payload shape instead of trusting the handler's `as` cast (Precedent: blank `trainerProfile` screen).
    - **Shared lookup maps (`STATUS_COLOR`, `TEMPLATE_LABELS`, icon maps)**: when adding a missing key, enumerate every backend enum value and caller string constant so zero keys fall through silently.
    - **Modal confirm actions**: verify the overlay library does not process `close: true` before `onClick: onConfirm` (silently turning Confirm into Cancel).
    - **Sibling-screen sweep**: when fixing shared cards, currency format (`vnd()`), or Zalo Mini App native capsule right-padding clearance (`SubHeader`), grep and update every sibling screen in the same commit.

rules.title: Shared icon vocabulary (`Icon` / `ICON`), zero Unicode icon glyphs, and `lint:icons` accessibility gate
rules.content: 17. **Shared icon vocabulary (`Icon` / `ICON`), zero Unicode icon glyphs, and `lint:icons` accessibility gate** — - **Concept-keyed registry in `packages/ui`**: render icons exclusively via `} size="md" />` (and `} />` on decorative hero/empty-state surfaces). If a domain concept lacks a key, add the concept key to `ICON` in `packages/ui` — never import `lucide-react` in app code or draw Unicode characters, fullwidth symbols, or emojis (`✓`, `✕`, `→`, `★`, `▣`, `＋` `\uFF0B`, `🔒`) in JSX. - **Guard shared keys in unit tests**: record every pair of concepts that intentionally share one icon component in `ICON_SHARED_KEYS` and assert in `packages/ui/tests/icon.test.ts` that unrecorded duplicates fail the build (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10, ADR-0008). - **Text vs. icon boundary (`scripts/lint-icons.mjs`)**: - Arrows inside string literals or `

rules.title: Encapsulate `URL.createObjectURL` & abort streams/timers on unmount
Port animations by script, preserve library motion, and key page-enter by pathname
rules.content:
19. **Port animations by script, preserve library motion, and key page-enter by pathname** — Extract `@keyframes` and usage counts from `.dc.html` by script (never eyeball or rebuild unimported CSS files) and audit all 3 layers (keyframes exist, utility class exists, markup carries class). Keep native motion on library-owned surfaces (`zmp-ui`, `sonner`, `recharts`) unless applying a verified property delta without geometry coupling. Wire route-change animations once via `
{children}
` and assert `getComputedStyle(el).animationName` in e2e (Precedent: XaDaoXa 2026-09).

rules.title: Assert scripted edits, inspect companion `.js` specs, and verify live `getComputedStyle` + both locales
rules.content:
20. **Assert scripted edits, inspect companion `.js` specs, and verify live `getComputedStyle` + both locales** —
    - Every scripted find-and-replace must assert the file changed (formatter reflows turn silent no-ops into false "done" reports — Precedent: VibeHost 2026-10).
    - Read both `.dc.html` and its companion `.js` files (motion, timers, and computed display values often live in scripts).
    - Verify live `getComputedStyle(el)` (`paddingTop`, `paddingLeft`, `marginLeft`, `maxWidth`, `width`, `backgroundImage`, `color`) on `<main>`, `<aside>`, and `<header>` in the browser rather than trusting source class strings.
    - Scan rendered page text in both VI and EN for leaked function words of the other language after any i18n change.

rules.title: Centralize UI/UX specifications in root `DESIGN.md` & wire `AGENTS.md` to it
rules.content:
21. **Centralize UI/UX specifications in root `DESIGN.md` & wire `AGENTS.md` to it** —
    - **Single design & copy source of truth (`DESIGN.md`)**: keep tier `GLOSSARY.md` files strictly as pure glossaries of domain/presentation terms. Co-locate all UI/UX design rules in a root `DESIGN.md` and link it from `AGENTS.md` and `GLOSSARY-MAP.md` so every frontend or design-porting agent loads it on demand:
      1. Aesthetic direction & `@theme inline` token system (`packages/ui/tokens.css`, enforced by `lint:tokens`).
      2. Shared UI primitive inventory & concept-keyed icon vocabulary (`@scope/ui`, enforced by `lint:icons`).
      3. Component naming by domain role (e.g. `request-subject-step.tsx`, `request-done-screen.tsx` — never sequential wizard step numbers `step-1.tsx`..`step-4.tsx` that rot when steps reorder), flat domain-grouped folder structure, and `≤ 300`-line file size cap without prop-drilling screen shells.
      4. Responsive & adaptive layout rules (`375px` Mobile, `768px` Tablet, `1024px–1440px` Desktop) — 100% navigation reachability below `1024px`, responsive drawer/sheet drilldowns for multi-column split panes, `overflow-x-auto` for dense schedule/comparison grids, and CSS-first breakpoints (`md:`/`lg:`/`xl:`) over `window.innerWidth` state.
      5. User-facing copy voice/pronouns per surface, the canonical **Term table** (internal term → displayed VI/EN), and the **End-User vs Admin Console copy boundary** (`rules/i18n.md` #8, #10, enforced by `packages/i18n/tests/leak.test.ts`).

rules.title: Pure modules must not import UI or React-query hooks
rules.content: 22. **Pure modules must not import UI or React-query hooks** — Files named `*-vm.ts`, `*-api.ts`, `*-model.ts`, or `*-model.tsx` must stay free of `@giasuanhminh/ui` (and any UI package) and of `@tanstack/react-query` hooks, so `bun test` can import them: the UI package pulls `next/font`, which crashes the Bun test runner. Enforce with a deterministic check (`no-restricted-imports` scoped to those globs, or a depcruise rule) rather than review. If a pure module needs an icon or component, return a discriminator (`"success" | "failure"`) and map it to the icon in the consuming component. Precedent: giasuanhminh refactor 2026-10.

rules.title: Default `optimizePackageImports` for barrel-heavy deps
rules.content: 23. **Default `optimizePackageImports` for barrel-heavy deps** — add `optimizePackageImports: ["@sentry/nextjs", "zod", "axios", "shiki", "@shikijs/langs"]` (and any other barrel-exported dependency) to `experimental` in every app's `next.config`. Cheap, safe, reduces client bundle size. Precedent: VibeHost 2026-10 bundle audit.

rules.title: `next/dynamic` for above-the-fold-but-deferrable islands
rules.content: 24. **`next/dynamic` for above-the-fold-but-deferrable islands** — large client components that are not needed for first paint (status boards, charts, editors) should be loaded with `next/dynamic({ ssr: false })` to split them out of the initial bundle. Precedent: VibeHost 2026-10 bundle audit.

rules.title: Auth-gate allowlists normalize home and ship a negative test
rules.content: 25. **Auth-gate allowlists normalize home and ship a negative test** — A public-path list stores `/` for home, never `''`; the matcher is `pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(p + '/')`. With `''`, `startsWith('/')` makes every route public. Add a unit test that a private path stays closed and the public landing page stays open. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — `PUBLIC_PATHS` contained `''`; the proxy gate was inert and every live route was masked as public.

rules.title: One typed route/role registry per app
rules.content: 26. **One typed route/role registry per app** — Path, role, view id, breadcrumb, and public/private live in one module. No parallel role arrays, crumb maps, or `go('view')` literals. A missing route is a type error; a new public page is one row. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — role vocabulary lived in three files and view/path maps in five.

rules.title: Cache appliers read the factory's prefix length, not raw indexes
rules.content: 27. **Cache appliers read the factory's prefix length, not raw indexes** — A cache module that patches a query key must derive its offset from the key factory (`portalKeys.kyc.verification.base.length`) and compare discriminators. `queryKey[4]`/`[5]` silently binds to a different key when the factory grows.

rules.title: IME composition safety on custom Enter keydown listeners (`isImeSafeEnter`)
Standard cross-browser scrollbars in `@layer base` (`scrollbar-color` & `scrollbar-width`)
rules.content:
29. **Standard cross-browser scrollbars in `@layer base` (`scrollbar-color` & `scrollbar-width`)** —
    - Never style scrollbars with vendor-prefixed `::-webkit-scrollbar` alone (ignored by Firefox). Declare standard Baseline `scrollbar-color: var(--line-2) transparent; scrollbar-width: thin;` wrapped in `@layer base` for Tailwind v4 cascade hygiene.
    - Keep `::-webkit-scrollbar` pseudo-elements alongside standard CSS without `@supports not` suppression so Chromium/WebKit preserve refined gutter and thumb insets while Firefox renders branded colors (Precedent: VibeHost 2026-11 MWG audit).

rules.title: Form controls style `:user-invalid` and `aria-invalid`
rules.content:
30. **Form controls style `:user-invalid` and `aria-invalid`** —
    - Shared text controls (`Input`, `Textarea` in `@scope/ui`) must style `aria-invalid:border-danger/80 aria-invalid:focus-visible:ring-danger/50 user-invalid:border-danger/80 user-invalid:focus-visible:ring-danger/50`.
    - Error borders appear only after initial user interaction or submit attempt, preventing premature error borders on untouched inputs while synchronizing programmatic accessibility state (`aria-invalid`) with visual pseudo-states (Precedent: VibeHost 2026-11 MWG audit).

rules.title: Primary media LCP prioritization (`fetchpriority="high"` / `priority`)
rules.content:
31. **Primary media LCP prioritization (`fetchpriority="high"` / `priority`)** —
    - Primary above-the-fold raster media (hero graphics, blog cover images, main product banners) rendered via `next/image` must set `priority` to emit early `<link rel="preload">` hints and `fetchpriority="high"`, eliminating Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) delays.
    - Retain `loading="lazy"` on below-the-fold or non-critical raster assets (e.g. partner logo walls) to prevent network contention with initial render scripts (Precedent: VibeHost 2026-11 MWG audit, ADR-0023).

rules.title: Read the design spec source that the task actually has
rules.content: 32. **Read the design spec source that the task actually has** — The source is not fixed. When Figma MCP is available, read the wireframe from it. When the task ports a Claude Design `.dc.html` export, read that export (see the `claude-design-to-nextjs` workflow). When neither exists, use the written wireframe or spec. Compare the rendered output with that source and report the difference. A task with no design source still completes under rule #33.

rules.title: Agentic verification scope
rules.content:
32a. **Agentic verification scope** — Apply this verification loop:

Applies to every agent that writes browser UI. The agent owns verification before it reports the task done. Precedent: Policybazaar and Pensionbazaar 2026-11 — 92% less manual audit effort, >90% faster screen delivery, >90% fewer UI bugs.

rules.title: No frontend task is done until the rendered page is checked
rules.content: 33. **No frontend task is done until the rendered page is checked** — Before reporting completion, inspect the rendered page in a real browser: read the DOM and computed CSS, resize to each supported viewport, read console errors, and record one performance trace. A source-only diff is not a completed frontend task. Completion criterion: the coverage matrix in `rules/real-user-qa.md` has no blank cell. Judgement call: the reviewer checks the matrix; no lint rule can judge it.

rules.title: Give the correction loop exit criteria
rules.content: 34. **Give the correction loop exit criteria** — Set a maximum number of correction iterations and explicit pass/fail conditions before the loop starts. Stop at the limit, report the remaining failures, and ask for a human decision. An open-ended loop wastes tokens. Mechanical check: assert the step limit exists in the agent instruction file (prompt or skill) in CI.

rules.title: Split browser modes by purpose
rules.content: 35. **Split browser modes by purpose** — Use the signed-in browser (browse MCP) for functional workflow walks as rule `rules/real-user-qa.md` #3 requires. Use a clean isolated browser (`--isolated`) for performance traces, visual audits, screenshots, and generated reports: extensions, cached data, and personal data cannot change the result. Judgement call: the reviewer checks that reported audit screenshots come from the clean instance.

rules.title: Ship a verified QA report with the diff
rules.content: 36. **Ship a verified QA report with the diff** — The report carries a visual comparison against the design spec source from rule #32 (pixel diff plus screenshots at each supported viewport), Core Web Vitals and performance diagnostics from the trace, Lighthouse scores for SEO, best practices, and accessibility, and pass/fail rows for interactions, console errors, and state changes. Mechanical check: assert the report file exists in CI; the reviewer judges its content.

rules.title: Load Modern Web Guidance before HTML, CSS, or client-side JS work
rules.content: 37. **Load Modern Web Guidance before HTML, CSS, or client-side JS work** — When a task writes, reviews, or ports browser UI, load the `modern-web-guidance` skill first (install with `npx modern-web-guidance@latest install` when absent). The skill is the single source of truth for web platform, performance, accessibility, security, and Baseline rules. Where the skill and a base-model habit disagree, follow the skill. Route a missing web fact upstream: open an issue or contribute to `GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src` instead of adding a rule here; keep this file for repo-specific implementations only. Scan a finished slice with `npx modern-web-guidance legacy-scan <slice> --json` before review (`rules/audit.md` #18). Mechanical check: assert the skill is present in the agent config in CI; the reviewer checks the scan output on the diff. Precedent: Policybazaar and Pensionbazaar 2026-11 — base models were ~70% aligned with best practice and 12 guidance rules closed the gap. Chrome 2026-11 eval — unguided agents passed ~50% of checks versus ~90% with guidance across 10 recurring failure areas.

--- id: "frontend" name: "Frontend Rules — web, portal, miniapp" kind: "rule" description: "Applies to browser clients in the organization (React/Next.js web apps, admin portals, mobile-web miniapps). Repos with i18n additionally include `rules/i18n.md`." scope: "Web, portal, miniapp" priority: "mandatory" --- # Frontend Rules — web, portal, miniapp 0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies. Applies to browser clients in the organization (React/Next.js web apps, admin portals, mobile-web miniapps). Repos with i18n additionally include `rules/i18n.md`. ## API consumption & Ponytail mock hooks (mandatory) 1. **Axios generic type parameter, never manual unwrap** — Declare response types via `const { data } = await api.get('/endpoint')` and return `data`. Never write `data?.data as Type` or custom `unwrap()` helpers — the `lib/client.ts` response interceptor unwraps `{ data: T }` envelopes. 2. **Native multipart helpers & `FormData` passthrough** — Use `api.postForm()` / `putForm` / `patchForm` for uploads; never hand-roll `toFormData` (native helpers skip `undefined`/`null`, repeat `File[]` per key, and match the server serializer). *Sole exception*: a single port-boundary `toFormData` inside a transport-agnostic `RequestPort` (`@repo/api-client` / `@scope/contracts`) shared with a `fetch` adapter, which **must** accept `Record | FormData` and pass pre-built `FormData` instances through untouched (`body instanceof FormData ? body : toFormData(body)` — passing `FormData` into `Object.entries` yields `{}` and sends an empty upload body; Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). 3. **Wire real API data once the endpoint exists; use Ponytail mock hooks only before it lands** — Hardcoded counts, badges, or rows that contradict a live endpoint are bugs to fix in the same pass, not TODOs (Precedent: XaDaoXa 2026-09 sidebar vs header counts). When the backend endpoint does not exist yet, put module-level mutable mock state behind standard `useQuery`/`useMutation` hooks so component signatures never change on swap: ```ts // ponytail: module-level mutable mock store. Upgrade if: GET/POST /v1/items lands. const MOCK_ITEMS: Item[] = [...]; export const useItems = () => useQuery({ queryKey: ['items'], queryFn: async () => MOCK_ITEMS }); ``` ## Styling, Tailwind v4 & Colors (mandatory) 4. **Tailwind v4 utilities only** — No hand-rolled CSS files or inline `style={{}}` objects. Use v4 utility names (`shadow-xs`, `shadow-sm`, `rounded-xs`, `rounded-sm`, `shrink-0`, `outline-hidden`, `max-w-[24rem]`, `bg-linear- from-x to-y`; `ring-offset-*` is removed; `shadow-md/lg/xl` and `tracking-wider` remain valid). Check `AGENTS.md` or the theme config when unsure. 5. **Cascade-layer hygiene & `@source` in Tailwind v4** — In CSS Cascade Layers, **any unlayered rule beats every `@layer` rule** regardless of specificity (`* { margin: 0; padding: 0; }` unlayered zeroes out every `@layer utilities` `p-*`/`px-*`/`m-*`/`mx-auto` class). When porting `.dc.html` / `tokens.css` into a Tailwind v4 app (`@import "tailwindcss"`), drop duplicate resets or wrap element resets in `@layer base` and custom classes in `@layer components`. When `globals.css` sits in `apps/*/src/app/globals.css`, add `@source "../";` plus `@source` paths for shared UI packages (`@source "../../../../packages/ui/src";`) so Turbopack scans all components (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). 6. **Colors and dimensions are `@theme` design tokens, never literals (`lint:tokens` zero-baseline ratchet)** — Define shared tokens in `tokens.css` and app tokens in `globals.css` (`@theme inline`); reference them via generated classes (`bg-ph-bg`, `text-tier-low-strong`) or `var(--color-x)` in JS style maps. Replace Tailwind v3 arbitrary pixel values (`backdrop-blur-[2px]`, `max-w-[1280px]`, `text-[10px]`, `tracking-[0.2em]`) with Tailwind v4 tokens (`backdrop-blur-xs`, `max-w-7xl`, `text-xs`, `tracking-widest`). Once `scripts/tokens-baseline.json` reaches `{}` (`0` files holding legacy leaks), lock the baseline at zero so `lint:tokens` rejects any new `#hex` or `[...px]` literal immediately (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). Keep raw hex **only** where CSS variables cannot resolve: token definitions, `var(--color-x, #hex)` fallbacks, `themeColor` meta tags, ``, SVG `fill`/`stroke` attributes, and brand/chart-series data maps. ## Module boundaries, file shape & Next.js 16 (mandatory) 7. **Deep-module boundaries by default (`oxc/no-barrel-file: "error"`)** — Import workspace packages only through declared `package.json#exports` entry points (`@scope/pkg`, `@scope/pkg/subpath`) and import app-internal modules directly by file path (use relative paths when shorter than `@/` alias; keep same-folder imports relative). Forbid `export *` folder barrels. *Legacy exception*: in repos that have not enabled `oxc/no-barrel-file`, folders with ≥2 non-test files maintain an `index.ts` barrel and never import their own barrel from within the same folder. 8. **300-line hard cap (`max-lines: 300`), one screen = one file, fold into shared UI** — Target **≤250 formatted lines** when authoring new files and split >300-line monoliths in-place (behavior identical): multi-view screens → thin shell + per-view files; `hooks.ts` → per-domain `use-.ts`; `lib/data` → per-domain `.ts` (delete dead exports/mocks during the split). Shared multi-variant components live **once** in the shared UI package using `cva` + `import { cn } from 'cn'` — fold new tones/variants (`Badge`, `Input`) into the shared component and delete app-local copies (`Pill`, `Btn`, `INPUT_CLASS`). 9. **Route editor vs modal form** — Full-page create/edit flows share one route-editor component across `/path/new` + `/path/[id]` (`isNew = !id || id === 'new'`), never page-level `useState`. Use `*FormModal` dialogs only for inline edits triggered from a list page. 10. **Next.js 16 conventions (`src/proxy.ts` & default Turbopack)** — Name request hooks `src/proxy.ts` exporting `export function proxy(request: NextRequest)` (Next.js 16 ignores deprecated `middleware.ts`). Run `next dev` and `next build` with default Turbopack (never `--webpack`). Ignore `**/next-env.d.ts` in `.gitignore`, `.oxfmtrc.json`, and `.oxlintrc.json` so dev/build route-type switches never dirty git; delete any tool-scaffolded `apps/*/AGENTS.md`. In Bun multi-app monorepos, symlink `apps//node_modules/.bin -> ../../../node_modules/.bin` in `postinstall` (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). ## Data fetching, React Query & Forms (mandatory) 11. **Single Axios client in `lib/client.ts` & controller route/verb parity in `lib/api.ts`** — Configure `axios.create({ baseURL, headers })` with: (a) auth request interceptor, (b) response error interceptor normalizing messages to `` `${method} ${path} → ${status}` ``, and (c) response unwrap interceptor only if the API wraps `{ data: T }`. Endpoint functions live in `lib/api.ts`. Before wiring portal `lib/api.ts` functions against a backend module, verify the exact `@Controller('prefix')` + `@Get/@Post/@Patch/@Delete` path and verb in `apps/api` (e.g. plural `/tutors/me` vs `/tutor/me`, `/classes/client` vs `/client/classes`, `POST /finance/checkout` vs `GET`, `/admin/tutors/verification-queue` vs `/kyc-queue` — Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). Use `fetch` (sharing `baseURL` + `authHeader()`) **only** for SSE/NDJSON streaming endpoints. **Miniapp exemption**: Zalo miniapp keeps its local `fetch` client (`api/client.ts`) and local components (ADR-0039). 12. **`QueryProvider` & typed `use-.ts` hooks** — Wrap `QueryClientProvider` once at the root layout (`useState(() => new QueryClient())`); never fetch in `useEffect`. Centralize keys in `lib/query-keys.ts` and include `userId ?? 'anon'` on user-private caches; set `retry: false` on auth/session queries; update cache in a single layer (hook `onSuccess` OR form callback, never both); type `qc.setQueryData(key, ...)` via generic; extract multi-query cache transitions into pure unit-tested `applyEvent(qc, event)` helpers in `lib/data/-cache.ts`. 13. **Forms (`react-hook-form` + `zodResolver`) mirror the backend DTO** — Colocate `
-schema.ts` next to the form with a comment citing the backend DTO path; wire i18n error messages via `const schema = (t: TranslatorLike) => z.object(...)`. Skip RHF only for trivial `required`-only forms. - **Zod v4 input ≠ output (`z.coerce` / `.transform()`)**: pass three generics `useForm, unknown, z.output>()` (and `Control`) — never cast `as unknown as Resolver<...>`. Render coerced inputs as `value={field.value == null ? '' : String(field.value)}`. - **Input normalization parity**: strip formatting separators (`value.replace(/[\s.-]/gu, '')`) before regex checks (e.g. VN phone `/^0\d{9,10}$/`) and pair positive-number constraints with HTML `min="1"` (Precedent: Ecopick 2026-10, PR #452). ## JSX, React hooks & UI reliability (mandatory) 14. **Escape JSX entities & data-drive repeated blocks/collections** — Escape literal `'`, `"`, `<`, `>`, `{`, `}` in JSX text (`'`, `"`, `<`, `>`, `{`, `}`). Render repeated option/tab/field rows from module-level `{ value, labelKey } as const` arrays via `.map`. Replace accumulator loops (`out.push(...)`) with `.map` / `.flatMap` / `Array.from` / `Object.fromEntries` (keep `for`/`while` only for early-exit scans, sequential state machines, or side-effect loops), and extract duplicate loop bodies into a shared helper. 15. **Hooks run unconditionally before any early return** — Place every `useState`/`useEffect`/`useMemo` above all `if (isLoading) return ...` guards; a hook after an early return crashes React the instant `isLoading` flips (Precedent: tournament live-tracker crash). 16. **Verify untyped route registries, shared lookup maps, modal flags & sibling screens** — - **Dispatch tables (`params: unknown`)**: grep every real `go('screen', ...)` / `push(...)` caller to confirm the passed payload shape instead of trusting the handler's `as` cast (Precedent: blank `trainerProfile` screen). - **Shared lookup maps (`STATUS_COLOR`, `TEMPLATE_LABELS`, icon maps)**: when adding a missing key, enumerate every backend enum value and caller string constant so zero keys fall through silently. - **Modal confirm actions**: verify the overlay library does not process `close: true` before `onClick: onConfirm` (silently turning Confirm into Cancel). - **Sibling-screen sweep**: when fixing shared cards, currency format (`vnd()`), or Zalo Mini App native capsule right-padding clearance (`SubHeader`), grep and update every sibling screen in the same commit. 17. **Shared icon vocabulary (`Icon` / `ICON`), zero Unicode icon glyphs, and `lint:icons` accessibility gate** — - **Concept-keyed registry in `packages/ui`**: render icons exclusively via `} size="md" />` (and `} />` on decorative hero/empty-state surfaces). If a domain concept lacks a key, add the concept key to `ICON` in `packages/ui` — never import `lucide-react` in app code or draw Unicode characters, fullwidth symbols, or emojis (`✓`, `✕`, `→`, `★`, `▣`, `＋` `\uFF0B`, `🔒`) in JSX. - **Guard shared keys in unit tests**: record every pair of concepts that intentionally share one icon component in `ICON_SHARED_KEYS` and assert in `packages/ui/tests/icon.test.ts` that unrecorded duplicates fail the build (Precedent: Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10, ADR-0008). - **Text vs. icon boundary (`scripts/lint-icons.mjs`)**: - Arrows inside string literals or `

entries.title: General Rules — cross-project, framework-agnostic
entries.name: General Rules — cross-project, framework-agnostic
entries.description: Applies to every project in the organization.
entries.scope: All projects

rules.title: Module context
rules.content:
0. **Module context** — Apply this context when the module applies.

Applies to every project in the organization.

> **Moved to domain modules**: Axios generics & `postForm` → `rules/frontend.md` (#1–#2); Ponytail React Query mock hooks → `rules/frontend.md` (#3); Tailwind v4 utility names → `rules/frontend.md` (#4); `DESIGN.md` design & copy contract → `rules/frontend.md` (#21); NestJS DTO validation, controller→service seam & `@ApiProperty` → `rules/nestjs.md` (#1, #6, #8); GitHub Actions concurrency (`ci-${{ github.ref }}` / `cd-${{ github.ref_name }}`) → `rules/github-actions.md` (#3); centralized `infra/docker/` & Dockerfile shapes → `rules/github-vps-deploy.md` (#9–#11).

rules.title: Postgres: always Docker, never native install
rules.content: 1. **Postgres: always Docker, never native install** — Run `docker compose up -d postgres` from the repo's `docker-compose.yml` for any test, migration, or local-DB work; tear down with `docker compose down`. Never suggest `brew install postgresql*`, `/opt/homebrew/bin/psql`, or a Homebrew Postgres service.

rules.title: STE100 Simplified Technical English
rules.content: 2. **STE100 Simplified Technical English** — Always communicate in ASD-STE100. Use approved vocabulary, one meaning per word, and short sentences.

rules.title: `CONTEXT.md`, `GLOSSARY.md` & `DESIGN.md` separation of concerns
rules.content: 3. **`CONTEXT.md`, `GLOSSARY.md` & `DESIGN.md` separation of concerns** — Read the repo's `GLOSSARY.md` first and use its exact domain terms; call out any term conflict immediately. Define a term by its domain essence, not by its storage or deployment mechanism; keep the mechanism in an ADR. Precedent: Graveshift 2026-11 — `Project` was defined by an env-supplied scope value until the owner clarified it is a console-created entity with one numeric id shared with Sentry. Keep every `GLOSSARY.md` strictly a pure glossary of domain concepts (never dump CSS tokens, responsive rules, component folder conventions, or copy tables into `GLOSSARY.md`). Put all UI/UX design specifications, tokens, icon rules, component naming, responsive rules, and user-facing copy tables in root `DESIGN.md` and point `AGENTS.md` to `DESIGN.md` (`rules/frontend.md` #21).

rules.title: Project context
rules.content: 3a. **Project context** — Read the project's `CONTEXT.md` files when present and use their domain language.

rules.title: Vietnamese diacritics
rules.content: 4. **Vietnamese diacritics** — Always use accurate thanh điệu (diacritics) in Vietnamese copy and comments. Verify before committing.

rules.title: Ladder: `delete → stdlib → native → search → dep → one-liner → minimal code`
rules.content: 5. **Ladder: `delete → stdlib → native → search → dep → one-liner → minimal code`** — Stop at the first rung that holds, and never skip the search rung. For any concern with locale, Unicode, date/time, cryptography, parsing, or money edge cases, check `rules/libraries.md` first: when edge cases are non-trivial and enumerable, the baseline library wins (`slugify` for Vietnamese slugs; `motion` for staggered/interruptible/scroll-linked sequences vs plain CSS for a single keyframe; `getPageItems()` + CSS over `react-paginate`). Never add speculative abstractions (an interface with one implementation, a factory for one product). Deletion beats addition; shortest diff wins. Mark every deliberate simplification with `// ponytail: <ceiling>, <upgrade if ...>`.

rules.title: Zero `no-trigger` debt before merge
rules.content: 6. **Zero `no-trigger` debt before merge** — Every `ponytail:` comment is tracked tech debt. Harvest before merge with `grep -rnE '(#|//) ?ponytail:' . --exclude-dir={node_modules,.git,.next,dist}`, group as `<file>:<line> — <what>. ceiling: <limit> upgrade: <trigger>`, and tag any marker lacking `if`/`when`/`Upgrade` as `no-trigger`. Fix or add the trigger so `0 no-trigger` remains before shipping.

rules.title: Check affected apps before editing
rules.content:
7. **Check affected apps before editing** — In a monorepo, grep sibling apps before changing any shared contract, and fix or document both sides in the same PR:
   - **Backend edit (`apps/api/`)** → grep `apps/web/`, `apps/portal/`, `apps/miniapp/`, `packages/api-client/` for the route, response shape, field name, or error code.
   - **Frontend edit** → verify the endpoint, DTO shape, and error codes in `apps/api/`.
   - **Shared package edit (`packages/utils`, `packages/ui`)** → grep all `apps/` for imports of the changed export.

rules.title: Suggest rule updates, never deviate silently
rules.content: 8. **Suggest rule updates, never deviate silently** — When a rule is wrong, outdated, or missing for the task at hand, tell the user and propose an update to `rules/*.md` in `The-Resonance-Team/skills` (`main`). Never silently ignore a rule.

rules.title: Time handling uses `date-fns` + `@date-fns/tz`
rules.content: 9. **Time handling uses `date-fns` + `@date-fns/tz`** — All parsing, arithmetic, boundaries, and display use `date-fns` + `@date-fns/tz` (target timezone `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`). Wire serialization is the sole exception (`toISOString()`). Compute day/month boundaries via `new TZDate(d, TZ)` — never `new Date(y, m, d)`, `.toISOString().slice(0, 10)`, `.getUTCDay()`, or `.getDay()` (timestamps between 00:00 and 07:00 ICT fall on the previous UTC day). Date-fns-exempt miniapps use `Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' })`. Fixture dates use the one timezone anchor in `rules/fixtures.md` #4.

rules.title: Keep hand-written identifiers ≤ ~30 characters
rules.content: 10. **Keep hand-written identifiers ≤ ~30 characters** — Drop qualifiers the file or module already implies (`findAvailabilityTemplateForSlot` inside `appointments.repo.ts`, `FeedbackReportTransitionPayload` inside `feedback`). Exempt: generated Prisma types, DB constraint names, wire error codes, and `SCREAMING_CASE` constants (unless a word is redundant: `MAX_OPEN_PENDING_ORDERS` → `MAX_PENDING_ORDERS`). Audit with `grep -rhoE "[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]{34,}" src --include="*.ts"`.

rules.title: Import specifiers never carry file extensions
rules.content: 11. **Import specifiers never carry file extensions** — Write `from './portal'`, never `from './portal.ts'` or `from './portal/index.js'`. Keep `allowImportingTsExtensions` off.

rules.title: Incremental strangle, behavior identical
rules.content: 12. **Incremental strangle, behavior identical** — Ship one page, component, or module slice per PR (ADR-0039 rejected big-bang rewrites). A refactor preserves exact runtime behavior; visual drift is allowed only when explicitly documented in the ADR/plan, and behavior changes require a separate feature PR.

rules.title: Deletion over addition & single canonical signature
rules.content: 13. **Deletion over addition & single canonical signature** — Delete dead routes, dead exports, unused CSS, and obsolete mock layers during the refactor. Never add union-parameter overloads (`Options | Mode`), runtime shape branches (`instanceof Set`, `'field' in obj`), dual field-name fallbacks (`a.start ?? a.startTime`), or pass-through re-exports (`export { X } from ...`) to keep old in-repo call shapes alive — update every in-repo caller in the same slice. Leave zero lint suppressions (`oxlint-disable max-lines`).

rules.title: Partition subagents by directory path, never by rule
rules.content: 14. **Partition subagents by directory path, never by rule** — Never let two subagents edit the same directory concurrently (prevents mid-file merge corruption, duplicate imports, and `git checkout` clobbers). One directory = one owner.

rules.title: Run the verification gates yourself in strict order (`bun fmt` first)
rules.content: 15. **Run the verification gates yourself in strict order (`bun fmt` first)** — A subagent's "done" report is a claim, not proof. On the merged tree, run: (1) `bun fmt`, (2) `bun lint --no-script --max-warnings=0 --allow-unsupported`, (3) typecheck (`bun check` / `tsc --noEmit`), (4) targeted tests. Running `bun fmt` first is mandatory because formatting expands single-line JSX/objects and exposes `max-lines: 300` overruns. Check `git status` and delete tool-generated untracked files (`apps/*/AGENTS.md` from Next.js 16, `.tmp-screenshots/`) before staging. In network/FS-sandboxed shells, invoke `bun fmt` and `./node_modules/.bin/{vitest,tsc}` directly, and use `bun run --filter '*' typecheck` / `bun run --filter '*' test` when `turbo` fails reading host `~/Library/Application Support/turborepo/auth.json`. Keep conventional commit headers and body lines ≤100 characters (`commitlint` `header-max-length` / `body-max-line-length`).

rules.title: Rotate a long-lived worker before its context grows stale
rules.content: 24. **Rotate a long-lived worker before its context grows stale** — One worker reused across sequential tasks must stay under **150k tokens**; **200k tokens is the absolute ceiling**. When the worker passes **40% of its context window**, stop assigning it new tasks even if it is still healthy: write a handoff file listing completed work, open items, changed paths and verification results; start a fresh worker with that handoff as its first input; close the old worker terminal. Do not keep one terminal only to preserve an already-accepted prompt. Precedent: Graveshift 2026-11 — one Kiro CLI v3 terminal ran eight tasks, passed 40% context, and had to be replaced before the remaining tasks.

rules.title: Trace blank/wrong renders and ellipses backward through the full pipeline
rules.content: 16. **Trace blank/wrong renders and ellipses backward through the full pipeline** — Before patching a component with a fallback or CSS tweak: (a) verify whether the DB `select`/projection, server response, and client mapper actually send the field, comparing against a working sibling endpoint/screen; (b) check whether a visible `…` truncation is literal seed/DB data rather than CSS `truncate`/`line-clamp`.

rules.title: Sweep the root-cause class & lock every fix with a regression test
rules.content: 17. **Sweep the root-cause class & lock every fix with a regression test** — A missing lookup-map key, missing DTO validator, or missing `.env` default is rarely a one-off: grep for the same shape across the repo and fix all sibling instances in the same pass (Precedent: XaDaoXa 2026-08). Every bug fix ships in the same PR with a unit or e2e test that fails before and passes after, naming the incident.

rules.title: Toolchain profile: `pnpm@12.3.1` or `bun@1.x` from `packageManager` (never corepack)
rules.content:
18. **Toolchain profile: `pnpm@12.3.1` or `bun@1.x` from `packageManager` (never corepack)** —
    - **pnpm repos**: Pin `pnpm@12.3.1` in `package.json#packageManager`. In `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, declare `allowBuilds` for native/postinstall packages (`@node-rs/argon2`, `@prisma/client`, `@swc/core`, `sharp`, `esbuild`, `@parcel/watcher`, `unrs-resolver`) and set `strictDepBuilds: false` (never use removed v10 `onlyBuiltDependencies`). When `minimumReleaseAge` is enabled, list intentional fresh upgrades in `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` using exact `name@version` or name-only wildcard `"@oxfmt/binding-*"` (never versioned wildcards `"@scope/pkg-*@1.2.3"`).
    - **Bun-native repos** (`packageManager: "bun@1.x"` declared in `AGENTS.md`): use `bun install` (`--frozen-lockfile` in CI/Docker), `bun fmt` (`bun fmt --check` in CI, reading static root `.oxfmtrc.json` with `oxfmt` package removed and verified via `bun fmt --doctor`), `bun check` for typechecking, and `bun test --check` by default (`vitest` only when `vi.hoisted`, browser mode, or branch coverage is required). Workspace packages whose `exports` point at source (`./index.ts`, never `dist/`) set `"build": "bun check"`, `"typecheck": "bun check"`, `"format": "bun fmt"`, and `"format:check": "bun fmt --check"` — never `tsc -b` or `oxfmt` (there is nothing to emit, and dead emit measured 11.6× slower cold: 3326ms `tsc -b --force` vs 287ms `bun check` over six packages on Gia Su Anh Minh 2026-10). Restore `tsc -b` for one package only when it publishes declarations (`dist/` in `exports`).

rules.title: Finish every tool swap with a repo-wide grep for the old tool's name
rules.content: 19. **Finish every tool swap with a repo-wide grep for the old tool's name** — Remove stale dotfiles (`.lintstagedrc` shadowed by `package.json`), per-app scripts, sub-package `devDependencies`, and README rows in the same PR; prove completion with a second grep returning zero hits (Precedent: XaDaoXa 2026-09 Prettier→Oxfmt).

rules.title: Kill dev servers by process name & never nest git worktrees
rules.content: 20. **Kill dev servers by process name & never nest git worktrees** — `pkill -f "next start --port NN"` misses `next-server` processes and leaves stale servers answering checks; use a port-bound `dev:stop` script or verify zero survivors with `ps` (Precedent: VibeHost 2026-10). Keep git worktrees as sibling directories — never inside the source repo tree, where `git add -A` stages them as mode `160000` gitlinks (reject `160000` in pre-commit).

rules.title: Deletion closes every edge
rules.content: 21. **Deletion closes every edge** — Before deleting an export, route, model, flag, or dependency, prove no consumer with `rg -w <symbol>` across apps, packages, scripts, e2e, and docs. Delete tests, stubs, config entries, and package dependencies in the same commit; update ADR/PRD/README/CI comments and any framework shortcut. Run the package gate. A deletion that leaves a stale doc or dead test is not done. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — the push sender was gone but the ADR, CI comment, and Next config still described it.

rules.title: Guards fail closed
rules.content: 22. **Guards fail closed** — A guard that scans files fails when a file is missing; never catch the read error and continue. Test the negative case (a private path, a missing fixture, a foreign host). A guard that passes when its input is absent is a false green. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — the env contract guard checked a non-existent script and swallowed the error.

rules.title: Bulk edits are codemods
rules.content: 23. **Bulk edits are codemods** — For more than five files or any identifier rename, write a checked-in `scripts/<name>.ts` with a `--check`/dry-run mode, assert the expected occurrence count per file, and run it on a branch. Do not inline a 200-line heredoc or blindly replace a short identifier; substring matches mangle longer names and can truncate a file. Delete the script when the change merges. Precedent: Ecopick 2026-11 — blind replacements produced `VENDOR_VENDOR_PARTNER_SELECT` and one truncated spec.

rules.title: Diff docs against the base after a rebase
rules.content: 25. **Diff docs against the base after a rebase** — Conflict markers cover syntax only. Read every ADR and glossary entry the base PRs touched, then fix stale rules in the same PR. Completion: no accepted ADR contradicts the merged base. Precedent: Graveshift 2026-11 — 86 git conflicts resolved cleanly, yet ADR 0008 and ADR 0015 still held the old Fix-now rule of base PR #104.
